title: hopia obtusa
intro: Hopia obtusa, commonly known as the toothache tree or Asian toothache plant, is a plant species native to tropical Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating pain and reducing inflammation, making it a popular remedy for toothaches and other oral health issues. The health benefits of Hopia obtusa include its antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe sore throats and gums. The bioactive constituents of Hopia obtusa include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties.
